description.en: Seat at Sidon: 'The central coastal region, from just north of Haifa to Beirut ... included the entire area of Galilee' (Strickert); the Druze emirate of Mount Lebanon was under the oversight of the governors of Saida and Tripoli.
description.ar: المركز في صيدا: 'The central coastal region, from just north of Haifa to Beirut ... included the entire area of Galilee' [المنطقة الساحلية الوسطى، من شمال حيفا مباشرة إلى بيروت ... شملت منطقة الجليل كلها] (ستريكرت)؛ وكانت إمارة الدروز في جبل لبنان تحت إشراف واليي صيدا وطرابلس.
description.he: המושב בצידון: “The central coastal region, from just north of Haifa to Beirut ... included the entire area of Galilee” [אזור החוף המרכזי, ממש מצפון לחיפה ועד ביירות ... כלל את כל אזור הגליל] (סטריקרט); האמירות הדרוזית של הר הלבנון הייתה תחת פיקוחם של מושלי צידון וטריפולי.

sources.quote: The central coastal region, from just north of Haifa to Beirut, was governed by the coastal city of Sidon. This included the entire area of Galilee, from Acre east to Tiberias and Safed.
Osmanlı yönetimi, 17. yüzyılda Safad, Sayda ve Beyrut sancaklarını, Şam eyaletinden çıkartmış ve 1660 yılında Sayda Eyaleti kurulmuş, Safad ve Beyrut ise bu yeni eyalete sancak olarak bağlanmıştır

notes.en: Most of Galilee was in practice controlled by Zahir al-Umar from c. 1740s to 1775.

description.en: Seat at Acre (al-Jazzar 1775-1804, then Suleyman Pasha 1804-1818 and successors). In 1830 Jerusalem and Nablus, and the districts of Jaffa and Gaza, were also under Acre.
description.ar: المركز في عكا (الجزار 1775-1804، ثم سليمان باشا 1804-1818 وخلفاؤه). وفي 1830 كانت القدس ونابلس ولواءا يافا وغزة أيضًا تحت عكا.
description.he: המושב בעכו (אל-ג׳זאר 1775-1804, אחר כך סולימאן פאשה 1804-1818 ויורשיו). ב-1830 היו גם ירושלים, שכם/נאבלוס ומחוזות יפו ועזה תחת עכו.

sources.quote: was appointed governor of the Saida province in return for his services. Using Akka as his seat and power base, he quickly brought not only Beirut but also Tripoli under his direct rule.
when the moderate Süleyman Pasha replaced Cezzar as governor of Saida-Akka, from 1804 to 1818
Already in 1830, on the eve of Muhammad Ali’s invasion, the sanjaks of Jerusalem and Nablus were transferred to the control of Abdullah Pasha, the governor of Acre.
The districts of Jaffa and Gaza were then within the jurisdiction of Acre, the seat of the province of Sidon.
the three Sanjaqs of Jerusalem, Jaffa-Gaza, and Nablus were part of the Province of Damascus (Sham), while Acre was the seat of the Province of Saida.

description.en: Seat at Beirut; Acre a sanjak covering Galilee.
description.ar: المركز في بيروت؛ وعكا سنجق يشمل الجليل.
description.he: המושב בביירות; עכו סנג׳ק הכולל את הגליל.

sources.locator: section 'Administrative Reorganization in the Aftermath of Egyptian Withdrawal'
sources.quote: the seat of the Province of Saida was transferred from Acre to Beirut (though the province continued to carry the name of Saida).
the Ottoman government attempted to attach the Mountain directly to the Province of Saida, the seat of which had been appropriately moved to Beirut.
